requirements.center: One stable saddle/torso reference per orientation; register complete poses. Preserve explicit original battle trajectory without adding image-to-image jitter.
requirements.motion: Native class4 pose order, repeats, flips, offsets, projectile release and hit timings.
requirements.palette: At most16 purposeful colors per side. Ally soft blue and ivory/white dominant, small warm skin and natural wood/steel. Enemy dark blue-violet with readable cool highlights. Slightly muted, never graywashed.
requirements.anatomy: Complete continuous rider, cloak, saddle, horse barrel and four anatomically joined legs in every pose. No horizontal body swaps, row compression, synthetic knee warps or disconnected armor.
requirements.validation: Inspect actual whole-pose sheets, full-speed and slow loops at intended size on dark/light backgrounds; numeric connectivity and timing checks supplement visual inspection.

batches.purpose: Three complete compact left-facing map poses. Reuse whole0/2 for side walk; mirror whole sprites for opposite facing.
Rear and front full horse+rider pairs; same helmet, clothing and palette as accepted new map idle.
Six full battle-scale ground/gallop poses; native leg positions and single continuous lance.
Rear/leap/return/throw/release. Native grip and empty-hand release. Projectile kept external.

prohibited_shortcuts: Republish the failed v1/v2 sprites as a new drawing
Crop and splice clothing from different poses
Replace actual visual inspection with pixel counts
Claim automatic chat images are hidden or folded
tool_image_attachment_exception: User explicitly permitted built-in generation and visual inspection images for this redraw; final reply remains text and gallery link only.
